title: galium commune var. scabridum
intro: Galium commune var. scabridum, commonly known as the rough bedstraw, is a perennial herb that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, where its health benefits include soothing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Galium commune var. scabridum include its ability to act as a laxative and antispasmodic, while also exhibiting diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
